create_model_PiT: create a PiT (Patching) image classification model with configurable depth, heads, and patch size
build_transformer_attention: build a Transformer module with stacked Attention and FeedForward layers for sequence processing
create_PiT_forward_pass: run a forward pass through a PiT model on image tensors to produce classification logits
build_PiT_pooling_layer: build a Pool layer that downsamples spatial tokens via depthwise convolution and doubles channel dimensions
create_PiT_patch_embedding: create a patch embedding layer that converts images into patch sequences using nn.Unfold
